name: Monstruito
description: Gets the projects you choose ready to work on: pulls git, installs dependencies, opens each one's agent and commands, and can brief the agent to finish the job. Wraps up the day with a note for tomorrow.

cover.alt: Monstruito's black cat next to the name and the line "Get your projects ready when Orca opens"

statusBarItems.tooltip: Monstruito: click to run the startup now

settings.title: Run when Orca opens
settings.description: When off, it only runs from the panel button or the status bar. The panel asks the first time.

settings.title: Delay after Orca opens (seconds)
settings.description: Time Orca gets to finish loading before starting.

settings.title: Notify when done
settings.description: Desktop notification with the summary, and when the periodic check finds new commits.

settings.title: Check for new commits every (minutes)
settings.description: While Orca is open, fetches every so many minutes and flags the projects with commits not applied. 0 = never.

settings.title: Git
enumLabels: Fetch only, without moving the branch

settings.title: Rebase if the branch has diverged
settings.description: When you have local commits and the remote has new ones: git rebase onto the remote. On a conflict it runs git rebase --abort and leaves the branch as it was.

settings.title: Skip projects with uncommitted changes
settings.description: If tracked files are modified, nothing is pulled in that project.

settings.title: Fetch all branches and prune deleted ones
settings.description: git fetch --all --prune instead of only the current branch's remote.

settings.title: Update submodules
settings.description: git submodule update --init --recursive after moving forward.

settings.title: Report unpushed commits
settings.description: Counts the local commits that are not on the remote yet. Read-only.

settings.title: Report the other worktrees
settings.description: How many commits each of the project's Orca worktrees is behind. It doesn't move them.

settings.title: Agent model
settings.description: Empty = the one in its own configuration. For Claude: opus, sonnet, haiku or an id such as claude-opus-5-5. Copilot, Kimi and Droid always use their own. Better pick it in the panel, which offers the list.

settings.title: Model reasoning effort
settings.description: Only applies if you choose a model.

settings.title: Open the agent only if there are new commits
Startup prompt
settings.description: For "Summarize" (replaces the default summary) and "Always send my prompt". Variables: {project}, {branch}, {upstream}, {n_commits}, {commits}. With the brief, it is added as extra instructions.

settings.title: Seconds between agents
settings.description: Wait between opening one agent and the next.

settings.title: Install dependencies when they change
settings.description: If moving forward changes a lockfile (npm, pnpm, yarn, bun, composer, flutter, bundler, poetry, uv), runs its install before opening anything.

settings.title: Install missing dependencies
settings.description: If there is no node_modules, vendor, .dart_tool or .venv (a fresh clone), even when git changed nothing.

settings.title: Run each project's commands
settings.description: Commands are added in each project's gear, in the panel.
